verses.pali: ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā rājagahe viharati sappinītīre.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying near Rājagaha, on the bank of the Serpentine river.

verses.pali: Atha kho brahmā sanaṅkumāro abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṁ sappinītīraṁ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ aṭṭhāsi.
verses.english: Then, late at night, the glorious divinity Sanaṅkumāra, lighting up the entire Serpentine riverbank, went up to the Buddha, bowed, stood to one side,

verses.pali: Ekamantaṁ ṭhito kho brahmā sanaṅkumāro bhagavato santike imaṁ gāthaṁ abhāsi:
verses.english: and spoke this verse in the Buddha’s presence:
who take clan as the standard.
But one accomplished in knowledge and conduct
is best among gods and humans.”
That’s what the divinity Sanaṅkumāra said,

verses.pali: Atha kho brahmā sanaṅkumāro “samanuñño me satthā”ti bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṁ katvā tatthevantaradhāyīti.
verses.english: Then the divinity Sanaṅkumāra, knowing that the teacher approved, bowed and respectfully circled the Buddha, keeping him on his right, before vanishing right there.
